limits: Two openable rigid mold halves form the clear gel; the parting surface is the gel rear face.
No cure shrinkage compensation is assumed. Use compatibility/thickness coupons, smooth the cavity and measure the cured result.
Load gel into the open cavity, lower the lid slowly, and use fill/vent openings to release excess and bubbles.
M3 mold bolts are shop fixtures: choose measured grip length plus washers/nuts; do not print bolts as substitutes.
The flat marker pattern has arc-length spacing; the matching flexible stencil has the nominal curved contact surface.
White coating thickness, dot opacity, demolding and adhesion remain physical process acceptance items.
